lines.zh: 三格宽的身子碾过碎石
lines.en: My three-block bulk grinds over the rubble.

lines.zh: 每落一脚，地面就沉一寸
lines.en: Each footfall sinks the ground an inch.
Plate grinds against plate as I advance.
Five blocks tall, I duck through gates.
I drag my heavy tail along.
The water in the pipes trembles with me.
One stride clears the shallow trench.
Something rattles under my plates.
The smell of the sea walks with me.

lines.zh: 我沿着审判庭的外墙巡行
lines.en: I patrol the outer wall of the tribunal.
Steps crack beneath me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但没人敢挡
lines.en: I move slowly, and nobody dares block me.

lines.zh: 锤子在我肩上一下一下地撞
lines.en: My hammer knocks my shoulder with each step.

lines.zh: 二十多格的高塔，我抬头看
lines.en: I look up at the tower twenty blocks tall.

lines.zh: 我压过一片低矮的灌木
lines.en: I crush a field of low shrubs.
Two legs, like two pillars.

lines.zh: 我站着，阴影盖住半条街
lines.en: Standing, my shadow covers half a street.
Breathing inside this armor is slow.
I listen toward the sea.
Moisture beads on the iron face.
Without orders, I wait.
The hammer head rests on the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看远处翻涌的云
lines.en: I look at the churning clouds.
Twenty-two points of armor is heavy.
The tide sounds closer now.
My joints stiffen; let me slow.
I count the cracks in the wall.

lines.zh: 那东西不是海嗣，是别的
lines.en: That thing is not seaborn; something else.
In this armor, I would not get up again.
Wind pushes sea smell into my seams.
I lower my head to look at you.
You barely reach my knee.
I know the smell of the living.
Step into my shadow.
There is salt on your hands.
I have watched you a long while without moving.
You are not seaborn.

lines.zh: 你的刀还不到我一根手指
lines.en: Your blade is shorter than one of my fingers.
I will not chase unless you run.
I blink slowly.
The iron face dented.
A shallow hollow is left in my iron face.
Half a step back; I do not drop the hammer.
Something loosened between the plates.
I ring once, like a struck bell.
The joint is hit; I will move slower.
This damage does not matter.
I press a hand over the split.
You hit well enough.
I set my stance again.
That would not fill a tooth.
Put it down, then back away.
I eat what comes from the sea.
You should bring more.
I sniff; it is not fresh.
I neither refuse nor thank.

lines.zh: 铁手上接东西很不灵便
lines.en: Iron hands are clumsy at taking things.
Keep it away from my jaws.
That is half a meal.
You need to eat too, surely.
One shift of mine pushes you away.
You hit iron with a dull thud.
I do not stop.
I move my foot half a block.
Do not stand where I plant my feet.
My plate rakes your shoulder.
That jolt swayed my hammer.
The ground caves under us both.
You are so small I nearly missed you.
Get to the wall.
That does not suit me.
We were made, not born.
Comrades on the line are enough.
I guard the wall, not hearts.
I stand the hammer on the ground.
Among our kind, words are unnecessary.

lines.zh: 我更在意防线还在不在
lines.en: I care more whether the line holds.
Iron striking iron is our greeting.
Leave such words to the living.
I hold, you hold; that suffices.
I cannot bend; I nudge it with my foot.
I flick it up with the hammer haft.
So small a thing.
I pinch it between my fingers.
This is no seaborn part.
Keep it; it may serve.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指把它摆回去
lines.en: I set it back with two fingers.
I can feel its weight.
I pass it to the one behind me.
Nothing should lie in the road.
You have stepped onto the line.
My hammer is already raised.
The tribunal does not permit you through.
I can smell your breath.

lines.zh: 我跨一步，影子先到你身上
lines.en: I take one stride; my shadow reaches you first.

lines.zh: 别动，这是最后一次警告
lines.en: Hold. This is the last warning.

lines.zh: 海嗣在那边，你也在这边
lines.en: The seaborn are there; you are here.
I will not turn my back for you.
My iron shadow covers you.
The hammer head points your way.
I shift with your footsteps.
You cannot get around my width.
I need no speed; I have reach.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边就没有路了
lines.en: Backed to the wall, you have no road.
My gaze has not left you.
I keep this hammer for you.
The tide is rising; time is short.
You will not break this plate.
I shift one step forward.
Your breathing is too fast.
The hammer falls and the ground gives.
That will lay you out a while.
I swing a wide arm.
An iron arm comes down.
I send you flying.
The hammer's back meets your weapon.
I land and dust becomes a wall.
I pulled that blow.
This is the tribunal's force.
You are still standing. Good.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，身量很高
lines.en: I come out of the fog, very tall.
The ground sounds first; then me.
The tribunal's engine is in place.
I duck beneath the tower top.
The tide rises outside.
I raise the hammer; the iron rings low.
Someone has called me.
The plates lock together slowly.
I settle; the bricks crack.
Salt and blood on the wind.
Fire on iron; the heat comes through.
My whole leg jolts on landing.
Seawater floods my seams.
The blast shoves me off my spot.
Something lodges between plates.
The spell echoes inside my shell.
Even an iron shell goes hungry.
Lightning burns down the iron.
No bricks to stand on in the void.
